title: Gold read models, file version 0
description: The consumer-shaped Gold tables a domain pack publishes from its canonical model: which entity each reads, which columns it exposes under which names, and which columns name the custodian and the business date so that a watermark can say when a day is complete.

model_version.description: The canonical model version the read models read. A new model version does not change Gold until the read models move to it.

entity.description: Canonical entity the read model reads, by name.

custodian.description: Gold column that names the custodian; must be one of the columns, from a string column of the entity.

business_date.description: Gold column that names the business date the row belongs to; the watermark's grain. Omit for a snapshot the custodian publishes whole.

name.description: Column name as the consumer reads it.

source.description: Entity column it carries; defaults to the same name.

expression.description: SQL over the entity's columns, when the consumer column is derived; needs a type.
